conclusions.summary: niko-studio 与 Nowledge Mem 是互补而非替代关系。niko-studio 在叙事特化领域（叙事实体类型、时序覆盖链、冲突策略、叙事维度分析）具备 Nowledge Mem 无法提供的核心能力；Nowledge Mem 在通用知识管理（跨工具上下文、自动蒸馏、对话线程、社区导入）方面填补 niko-studio 短板。现有 CompositeBridge 双写桥接设计合理，集成范围中等，不需要大规模架构改动。

key_interfaces: KnowledgeService: createEntity, getEntity, searchEntities, createRelation, getRelations, resolveConflicts
GraphEngine: query, traverse, shortestPath, subgraph, addNode, addEdge
UnifiedMemory: store, recall, search, getTimeline, resolveConflict
INowledgeMemService: addMemory, getMemory, searchMemories, deleteMemory, updateMemory

dimension_2_retrieval.title: 检索能力对比

niko_studio.ranking: RRF (Reciprocal Rank Fusion) 融合向量+关键词排序
niko_studio.graph_queries: BFS/DFS traversal, shortest path, subgraph extraction, Jaccard similarity

dimension_2_retrieval.verdict: niko_studio_more_sophisticated (RRF fusion + FTS5 + graph traversal) | nowledge_mem_simpler_but_sufficient

dimension_3_bridge_design.title: 桥接设计评估
dimension_3_bridge_design.primary: KnowledgeMemoryEngineAdapter → UnifiedMemory (4层6维时序 + 叙事实体)
dimension_3_bridge_design.secondary: NowledgeMemKnowledgeBridge → INowledgeMemService (通用知识 + 跨工具)
dimension_3_bridge_design.write_strategy: 双写 (primary first, secondary async with silent degradation)
dimension_3_bridge_design.read_strategy: primary 优先, secondary 补充
dimension_3_bridge_design.failover: secondary 失败 → 静默降级到 primary-only, 无用户感知

mapping.Temporal chain → 当前有效状态: 仅同步当前有效状态, 不传 supersedes 历史

gaps: temporal_chain_not_bridged: supersedes 覆盖链不传递到 Nowledge Mem, 可能导致读取到过期状态
conflict_resolution_not_synced: 冲突解决结果不同步回 Nowledge Mem
summarize_not_utilized: Nowledge Mem 的 summarizeMemories 未被 niko-studio 调用, 浪费蒸馏能力

actions: 完善 NowledgeMemAdapter 实现 (当前仅 protocol + test, 缺少实现)
补全 CompositeBridge 的 temporal chain 同步
添加 bridge 健康检查和指标暴露
利用 summarizeMemories 从 AI 对话中自动蒸馏创作洞察回 knowledge base
冲突解决结果双向同步
Nowledge Mem Library 导入 → niko-studio 叙事实体结构化
Nowledge Mem 作为统一上下文层, niko-studio 作为叙事特化层, 共同服务多 AI 工具
社区知识图谱 → 叙事模板库
跨项目角色/世界观迁移
